name: Find
description: Represents the criteria for a find operation.
remarks: The properties and methods of the Find object correspond to the options in the Find and Replace dialog box. Use the Find property to return a Find object. The following example finds and selects the next occurrence of the word "hi." The following example finds all occurrences of the word "hi" in the active document and replaces the word with "hello." If you've gotten to the Find object from the Selection object, the selection is changed when text matching the find criteria is found. The following example selects the next occurrence of the word "blue." If you've gotten to the Find object from the Range object, the selection isn't changed when text matching the find criteria is found, but the Range object is redefined. The following example locates the first occurrence of the word "blue" in the active document. If "blue" is found in the document, myRange is redefined and bold formatting is applied to "blue."

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Find object.

properties.name: Forward
properties.description: True if the find operation searches forward through the document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns or sets a Font object that represents the character formatting of the specified object. Read/write Font.

properties.name: Found
properties.description: True if the search produces a match. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: MatchAllWordForms
properties.description: True if all forms of the text to find are found by the find operation (for instance, if the text to find is "sit," "sat" and "sitting" are found as well). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchCase
properties.description: True if the find operation is case-sensitive. The default is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchWildcards
properties.description: True if the text to find contains wildcards. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchSoundsLike
properties.description: True if words that sound similar to the text to find are returned by the find operation. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchWholeWord
properties.description: True if the find operation locates only entire words and not text that's part of a larger word. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchFuzzy
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word uses the nonspecific search options for Japanese text during a search. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchByte
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word distinguishes between full-width and half-width letters or characters during a search. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ParagraphFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a ParagraphFormat object that represents the paragraph settings for the specified find operation. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the style for the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text to find. Read/write String.

properties.name: LanguageID
properties.description: Returns or sets the language for the specified Find object. Read/write WdLanguageID.

properties.name: Highlight
properties.description: True if highlight formatting is included in the find criteria. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Replacement
properties.description: Returns a Replacement object that contains the criteria for a replace operation.

properties.name: Frame
properties.description: Returns a Frame object that represents the frame formatting for the specified style or find-and-replace operation. Read-only.

properties.name: Wrap
properties.description: Returns or sets what happens if the search begins at a point other than the beginning of the document and the end of the document is reached (or vice versa if Forward is set to False) or if the search text isn't found in the specified selection or range. Read/write WdFindWrap.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: True if formatting is included in the find operation. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LanguageIDFarEast
properties.description: Returns or sets an East Asian language for the specified object. Read/write WdLanguageID.

properties.name: LanguageIDOther
properties.description: Returns or sets the language for the specified object. Read/write WdLanguageID.

properties.name: CorrectHangulEndings
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word automatically corrects Hangul endings when replacing Hangul text. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NoProofing
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word finds or replaces text that the spelling and grammar checker ignores. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MatchKashida
properties.description: True if find operations match text with matching kashidas in an Arabic language document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchDiacritics
properties.description: True if find operations match text with matching diacritics in a right-to-left language document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchAlefHamza
properties.description: True if find operations match text with matching alef hamzas in an Arabic language document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchControl
properties.description: True if find operations match text with matching bidirectional control characters in a right-to-left language document. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MatchPhrase
properties.description: True ignores all white space and control characters between words. Read/write.

properties.name: MatchPrefix
properties.description: True to match words beginning with the search string. Read/write.

properties.name: MatchSuffix
properties.description: True to match words ending with the search string. Read/write.

properties.name: IgnoreSpace
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether a find operation should ignore extra white space in found text. Read/write.

properties.name: IgnorePunct
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether a find operation should ignore punctuation in found text. Read/write.

properties.name: HanjaPhoneticHangul
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to locate phonetic Hangul and hanja characters in a Korean language find operation. Read/write.

methods.name: ClearFormatting
methods.description: Removes text and paragraph formatting from the text specified in a find or replace operation.

methods.name: SetAllFuzzyOptions
methods.description: Activates all nonspecific search options associated with Japanese text.

methods.name: ClearAllFuzzyOptions
methods.description: Clears all nonspecific search options associated with Japanese text.

methods.name: Execute
methods.signature: Execute([FindText As Variant], [MatchCase As Variant], [MatchWholeWord As Variant], [MatchWildcards As Variant], [MatchSoundsLike As Variant], [MatchAllWordForms As Variant], [Forward As Variant], [Wrap As Variant], [Format As Variant], [ReplaceWith As Variant], [Replace As Variant], [MatchKashida As Variant], [MatchDiacritics As Variant], [MatchAlefHamza As Variant], [MatchControl As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Runs the specified find operation. Returns True if the find operation is successful. Boolean.

parameters.name: FindText
parameters.description: The text to be searched for. Use an empty string ("") to search for formatting only. You can search for special characters by specifying appropriate character codes. For example, "^p" corresponds to a paragraph mark and "^t" corresponds to a tab character.

parameters.name: MatchCase
parameters.description: True to specify that the find text be case-sensitive. Corresponds to the Match case check box in the Find and Replace dialog box (Edit menu).

parameters.name: MatchWholeWord
parameters.description: True to have the find operation locate only entire words, not text that is part of a larger word. Corresponds to the Find whole words only check box in the Find and Replace dialog box.

parameters.name: MatchWildcards
parameters.description: True to have the find text be a special search operator. Corresponds to the Use wildcards check box in the Find and Replace dialog box.

parameters.name: MatchSoundsLike
parameters.description: True to have the find operation locate words that sound similar to the find text. Corresponds to the Sounds like check box in the Find and Replace dialog box.

parameters.name: MatchAllWordForms
parameters.description: True to have the find operation locate all forms of the find text (for example, "sit" locates "sitting" and "sat"). Corresponds to the Find all word forms check box in the Find and Replace dialog box.

parameters.name: Forward
parameters.description: True to search forward (toward the end of the document).

parameters.name: Wrap
parameters.description: Controls what happens if the search begins at a point other than the beginning of the document and the end of the document is reached (or vice versa if Forward is set to False). This argument also controls what happens if there is a selection or range and the search text is not found in the selection or range. Can be one of the WdFindWrap constants.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: True to have the find operation locate formatting in addition to, or instead of, the find text.

parameters.name: ReplaceWith
parameters.description: The replacement text. To delete the text specified by the Find argument, use an empty string (""). You specify special characters and advanced search criteria just as you do for the Find argument. To specify a graphic object or other nontext item as the replacement, move the item to the Clipboard and specify "^c" for ReplaceWith.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: Specifies how many replacements are to be made: one, all, or none. Can be any WdReplace constant.

parameters.name: MatchKashida
parameters.description: True if find operations match text with matching kashidas in an Arabic-language document. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: MatchDiacritics
parameters.description: True if find operations match text with matching diacritics in a right-to-left language document. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: MatchAlefHamza
parameters.description: True if find operations match text with matching alef hamzas in an Arabic-language document. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: MatchControl
parameters.description: True if find operations match text with matching bidirectional control characters in a right-to-left language document. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.
